create_workdir_cuberite: create a Cuberite work directory with a flat world config, creative mode, and specified plugins
launch_cuberite_process: launch a Cuberite Minecraft server process with a given config, seed, game mode, port, and plugins
ping_cuberite_server: ping a running Cuberite server instance on localhost to verify it is responsive
destroy_cuberite_process: destroy a running Cuberite server process and verify it is no longer reachable via ping
test_cuberite_executable: test that the Cuberite server executable exists at the expected repository path
